$documentation: Dated, enumerated exemptions for the supply-chain bake-time gate
(scripts/check-dep-ages.mjs, run by the `Check production dep bake time` step in
An entry lets one exact-pinned version — in `dependencies`, `optionalDependencies`
or `overrides` — stay on a release published less than FLAIR_DEP_MIN_AGE_DAYS ago.
Every entry names the advisory it is a fix for and carries a hard expiry. An
expired entry FAILS the gate before any registry request; removing it lets the pin
be age-checked as usual. Re-read the reason before re-dating; removing the entry
once the version has aged past the window is the normal outcome.

entries.reason: 4.7.10 is the first patched release for all three advisories (affected >=4.0.0 <=4.7.9). A root `overrides` entry pins the @langchain/classic copy — a development and peer dependency of @tpsdev-ai/n8n-nodes-flair — to it. The pin clears the 7-day bake window on 2026-10-12.
